_comment: ALL SIX topological_offset cases are commented out -- the file names are parked in _commented_out below, and their configs are still in this directory. Nothing here runs. The 2D three (topological_offset_2d, _2d_vertex_input, _2d_dragon) came out first, while 2D was reworked to match 3D. The 3D three came out with them: the 2D and 3D optimizations now share one flow, and neither converges on the ESP-based offset potential, so registering them would only assert a known failure. Their configs also still carry keys the current topological_offset spec has deleted, and the spec is strict, so they would fail to parse. Re-add a name to integration_tests once its config parses against the spec and the case is expected to pass; the group is hidden ([.]) either way, so run it explicitly with ./wmtk_integration_tests "[offset]".
